A DNS server can set up its own top level domain without any say from the ICANN, the only limit there is that only DNS servers that are configured to recognize this particular servers as top level will take update from it.

Which mean setting up your own top level domain mostly mean making sure enough people recognize you as being responsible for it. For the rest of the Internet you can simply refer to the root servers.
